portfolio.name: Kees de Boekhouder and Founders Portfolio

products.name: Kees de Boekhouder for Sole Proprietors
products.description: The core subscription behind most of the more than 10,000 entrepreneurs Kees serves: a personal, internally trained bookkeeper plus the Kees web and mobile app for a fixed €840 per year ex VAT, invoiced monthly, for an eenmanszaak. The client photographs receipts, sends invoices and connects the bank in the app; the bookkeeper checks the administration, files the quarterly btw-aangifte with the Belastingdienst, prepares the annual accounts, applies the deductions (zelfstandigenaftrek, mkb-winstvrijstelling) and files the income tax return, and answers questions by e-mail and phone all year with proactive updates on deadlines and rule changes. Video or in-person meetings on request, colleagues as backup, multiple trading names per entity, no external accounting software needed. The first year covers a full fiscal year; afterwards the subscription is cancellable monthly with one calendar month notice.

primaryCustomers.name: Creative Freelancer
primaryCustomers.description: Gets a bookkeeper who understands creative work and an app that turns a shoebox of receipts into a checked administration with almost no time spent.

primaryCustomers.name: Knowledge Freelancer
primaryCustomers.description: Buys certainty on VAT, deductions, tax reservation and Wet DBA questions at a fixed fee instead of an hourly adviser or a software-only tool.

products.name: Kees Starters Package
products.description: The same €840 per year subscription positioned for entrepreneurs who have just registered at KVK, often next to a job: the bookkeeper walks the starter through the VAT number and first quarter, the choice for or against the KOR (VAT exemption up to €20,000 turnover), the startersaftrek (€2,123) on top of the zelfstandigenaftrek, the hours criterion and what to reserve for income tax, so the first btw-aangifte and first income tax return are right the first time. Includes the free Google Meet introduction, account set-up, first-upload coaching in the app and the starter articles from the advice knowledge base. Starters referred by a partner such as Stichting BOK receive the partner benefit at sign-up.

primaryCustomers.name: Starting Entrepreneur
primaryCustomers.description: Starts with the administration set up right from day one and learns what to deduct and reserve without reading the Belastingdienst site.

products.name: Kees for VOF Partnerships
products.description: One shared administration for two or more partners in a vennootschap onder firma at €1,140 per year ex VAT for two partners plus €100 per extra partner, invoiced monthly. The partners share one app account with per-partner access, the bookkeeper files one quarterly VAT return for the partnership, prepares the annual accounts with the agreed profit split and files each partner's income tax return with the correct share of profit and deductions, so every partner knows what he or she owes. Adding an employee (through payroll) or a partner does not require changing bookkeeper, and the transition to a BV is handled through Founders on the same platform.

primaryCustomers.name: VOF Partner
primaryCustomers.description: Runs one administration with the other partners and gets clarity on profit split and each partner's return at a fixed fee.

products.name: Founders for Holding BV and Werkmaatschappij
products.description: The fixed-fee BV proposition delivered by the sister company Founders (Founders Finance B.V., founded 2018, same Amsterdam address): €1,750 per year ex VAT for a holding BV and €2,450 per year for a werkmaatschappij, invoiced monthly. Founders' bookkeepers keep the general ledger, file the quarterly VAT return, prepare the statutory annual accounts and file them with KVK, prepare and file the corporate tax return (vennootschapsbelasting), run the DGA salary through the payroll add-on at €17.50 per payslip per employee per month, and advise on dividend, holding structures and the move from eenmanszaak to BV without losing the bookkeeper. The client uses the same web and mobile app for receipts, invoices, bank transactions and dashboard as every Kees client.

primaryCustomers.name: BV Director-Major Shareholder (DGA)
primaryCustomers.description: Keeps the BV compliant on corporate tax, annual accounts and KVK filing and pays himself correctly as DGA, all at a transparent yearly price.

products.name: Kees Client App and Dashboard
products.description: The proprietary client application at mijn.keesdeboekhouder.nl and in the iOS and Android app, included in every subscription. The dashboard shows revenue per quarter, cost categories, investments, profit, and the VAT to pay or receive per quarter, updated in real time as bookings are submitted, with a tax reservation indication for income tax. Around the dashboard sit the document archive with receipts, invoices, annual accounts and filed return copies, the to-do list and deadline reminders (quarterly VAT deadline on the last day of the month after the quarter, bank re-authorisation, missing documents), messaging with the personal bookkeeper, subscription and invoice overview, and the entrepreneur network profile. Login is personal, AVG-compliant, and data is visible only to the client and authorised Kees staff.

primaryCustomers.name: Creative Freelancer
primaryCustomers.description: Sees at a glance how the quarter is going and what is still needed, from the phone.

primaryCustomers.name: Knowledge Freelancer
primaryCustomers.description: Reads the real profit, VAT position and tax reservation at any moment before making decisions.

primaryCustomers.name: Starting Entrepreneur
primaryCustomers.description: Learns the rhythm of quarters, deadlines and reservations from the first login.

primaryCustomers.name: VOF Partner

products.name: Scan & Herken
products.description: Receipt and purchase-invoice capture included in the app: photograph a receipt with the phone, upload a PDF in the web app or forward a supplier e-mail to the personal e-mail-in address, and Scan & Herken recognises supplier, date, amount and VAT, proposes a cost category and creates the expense booking ready for the bookkeeper's review. Recognised bookings feed the dashboard immediately and are matched against bank transactions where a bank connection exists. The original image is stored in the document archive for the seven-year fiscal retention duty, so the physical receipt can be thrown away.

primaryCustomers.name: Creative Freelancer
primaryCustomers.description: Turns many small receipts from shoots, materials and travel into bookings in seconds.

primaryCustomers.name: Starting Entrepreneur
primaryCustomers.description: Builds the habit of capturing every expense from day one without learning bookkeeping.

products.name: Quotes and Invoices
products.description: Quotes, invoices and credit notes created in the app with the client's own logo and templates, under one or several trading names of the same entity, with the right VAT treatment (21%, 9%, 0%, VAT reverse charged, KOR exempt) applied automatically. A quote converts into an invoice, invoices are sent as PDF by e-mail with a payment link, status is tracked from sent to paid, overdue invoices trigger reminders and, with a bank connection, incoming payments mark invoices as paid automatically. Every invoice is a booking in the ledger, so revenue per quarter and VAT to pay are always current and the bookkeeper never has to re-key sales.

primaryCustomers.name: Creative Freelancer
primaryCustomers.description: Sends professional quotes and invoices from the phone and gets paid faster with reminders.

primaryCustomers.name: Knowledge Freelancer
primaryCustomers.description: Invoices a few larger clients hourly or fixed-fee with correct VAT and reverse-charge rules.

primaryCustomers.name: VOF Partner
primaryCustomers.description: Invoices under the partnership's trading names from one shared account.

products.name: Bank Connection (Bankkoppeling)
products.type: Paid Add-on (€5 per month per account)
products.description: A PSD2 bank connection through Ponto (Isabel Group, licensed PSD2 provider) to every Ponto-connected bank, including Knab, Rabobank, ABN AMRO and bunq, at €5 per month per connected account. After the client gives consent in the bank's own environment, transactions synchronise four times a day and are matched automatically against invoices, receipts and expense bookings; what remains is matched manually or booked directly from the transaction list. The connection must be re-authorised every 90 to 180 days depending on the bank, which the app reminds the client about. The bookkeeper sees a complete bank picture at quarter-end instead of asking for statements.

primaryCustomers.name: Knowledge Freelancer
primaryCustomers.description: Gets a complete, matched bank picture without uploading statements every quarter.

primaryCustomers.name: Creative Freelancer
primaryCustomers.description: Lets transactions flow in automatically and only touches what could not be matched.

primaryCustomers.name: VOF Partner
primaryCustomers.description: Connects the partnership's business account so all partners see the same bank truth.

products.name: Payroll Administration
products.type: Paid Add-on (€17.50 per payslip per employee per month)
products.description: Payroll for small employers and DGAs on top of the subscription at €17.50 per payslip per employee per month: employee or DGA data and contract terms are captured once, monthly payslips are produced as PDF in the document archive, the wage tax return (loonaangifte) is filed with the Belastingdienst, and the payroll journal entries land in the ledger so cost of labour and the tax position stay correct. Used by VOFs and sole proprietors who hire their first employee and, through Founders, by every BV that pays a DGA salary.

products.name: Partner Income Tax Return
products.description: The income tax return of the client's fiscal partner, prepared and filed by the personal bookkeeper for €125 including VAT per year. Because the entrepreneur's return and the partner's return are prepared together, joint items such as the owner-occupied home, mortgage interest, allocation of deductible items between partners and allowances are optimised across both returns, and the couple sees one combined picture of what they owe or receive. The partner's data and pre-filled Belastingdienst information are collected through the app, the return copy is stored in the archive, and the fee is invoiced with the monthly subscription invoice.

primaryCustomers.name: Knowledge Freelancer
primaryCustomers.description: Optimises house, mortgage and deductions across both partners' returns without a second adviser.

primaryCustomers.name: Creative Freelancer
primaryCustomers.description: Gets the partner's return done by the same bookkeeper who already knows the household situation.

products.name: Bookkeeper Workspace and QA Tooling
products.description: The internal back office in which roughly 40 Kees bookkeepers and team leads in Amsterdam, Rotterdam and Utrecht, together with the Founders bookkeepers, serve their client portfolios: a client file and review queue per bookkeeper with the submitted bookings, recognised receipts and matched transactions of each client, the general ledger with booking rules, VAT return and year-end preparation, income and corporate tax return preparation, the filing calendar that orchestrates every deadline across thousands of clients, four-eyes quality checks with findings, client allocation and workload planning across offices with colleagues as backup, the client messaging and call log, and the advice knowledge base with current tax rules. It is where the personal-bookkeeper promise is delivered at scale and where clients-per-bookkeeper is measured.

primaryCustomers.name: Personal Bookkeeper
primaryCustomers.description: Reviews every client administration and files on time with first-time-right quality while serving more clients per week.

primaryCustomers.name: Client Success and Sales Executive

products.name: Free Intro Call, Onboarding and Switch Service
products.description: The path from website request to active client: a free introduction via Google Meet booked from the website, a mutual-fit check in which the executive confirms the legal form, activities and expectations match the Kees way of working, plan choice per legal form, account access to the app, assignment of a personal bookkeeper by office and capacity, and coaching on the first uploads. For entrepreneurs switching from a previous bookkeeper the switch service collects digital copies of earlier VAT and income tax returns and personal data, imports the opening balances and history, and confirms there are no gaps in the VAT or income tax history before the first quarter is filed.

primaryCustomers.name: Client Success and Sales Executive
